commentary.ko:
한국-북한 관계이 가장 큰 변동을 보였다. 전체 지수는 어제 대비 3.34 상승하여 +2.22로 긴장 수준이 높아졌다. 군사 채널에서 서울이 평양과의 국경 충돌 방지를 모색한다는 보도가 있었지만, 평양의 국경군에 대한 강경 지시와 관련된 보도들이 긴장을 높였다. 외교 채널에서도 평양의 대남 비난 발언이 보도되면서 수치가 상승했으나, 다만 서울이 군사 회담을 제의했다는 보도도 함께 나왔다.

The Korea-North Korea relationship showed the largest movement. The overall index rose 3.34 points from yesterday to reach +2.22, indicating heightened tension levels. Although Seoul's efforts to prevent border clashes were reported in the military channel, reports on Pyongyang's strong directives to border troops elevated tensions. In the diplomatic channel, tensions rose with reporting on Pyongyang's critical statements toward the South, though reports of Seoul's military talks proposal also appeared.

한국-일본, 한국-중국, 한국-미국, 한국-러시아 관계는 모두 음수 범위에서 협력 쪽으로 유지되었다.
commentary.en:
The Korea-North Korea relationship showed the largest movement. The overall index rose 3.34 points from yesterday to reach +2.22, indicating heightened tension levels. Although Seoul's efforts to prevent border clashes were reported in the military channel, reports on Pyongyang's strong directives to border troops elevated tensions. In the diplomatic channel, tensions rose with reporting on Pyongyang's critical statements toward the South, though reports of Seoul's military talks proposal also appeared.

Relations with Japan, China, the United States, and Russia all remained in negative territory, indicating the cooperative direction.
